" ) def render_blog_post(author_id: str, post_heading: str, content: str, labels: list[str]) -> str: """ Generate a safe HTML representation of a blog post. Parameters ---------- author_id : str Identifier of the user who created the post. post_heading : str Heading/title of the post. content : str Main body of the post. May contain user-provided text. labels : list[str] Tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str XSS‑protected HTML string containing the rendered post. """ # Escape all user-supplied text to neutralise any HTML/JS injection safe_author_id = html.escape(author_id, quote=True) safe_heading = html.escape(post_heading, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=False) # content may contain newlines # Render each label as a element with escaped text safe_labels = " ".join( f"{html.escape(label, quote=True)}" for label in labels ) # Insert escaped values into the template rendered = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author_id=safe_author_id, post_heading=safe_heading, content=safe_content, labels=safe_labels ) return rendered
